narrative: On the board. A short note under the brackets. Less paper used than the morning had in mind. The captain's tick is already dry. On the board. One line in the right margin, smaller, under the four names. The pen is down. The Flint leaf is still Sunday's leaf. On the board. The captain's page pulled to the top. The others left in order. Nothing added to Flint.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the margin, saw how little was new, and stopped.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Some are only a cough
